evaluationNotes: Automated heuristic scoring from System.Description, Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria, System.Parent, Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Risk, and Custom.Riskdescription.
Risk classification uses Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Risk (1–3). Risk description uses Custom.Riskdescription when risk is 1 or 2.

stories.title: PE Designer Component - Create a Milestone

topSystemicIssues: Unset or invalid Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Risk; populate Risk (1–3) and Risk description when risk is 1–2.
Many standard stories deviate from strict As a / I want / so that and Gherkin AC; see per-item issues.
quickWins: Add Given/When/Then to Acceptance Criteria field for stories with bullets-only AC.
Shorten or split very large descriptions that look like multi-sprint specs.
